'''Dug''' was the native language of the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="TCWCG" />

As Dugs were a subservient species to the [[Gran/Legends|Grans]], Dug language was not as widely used as Dugs would prefer it to be since the [[Gran (language)/Legends|Gran language]] was usually preferred.

Although many Dugs were forced to learn Gran, most of them decided not to learn [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], hoping to force others to learn Dug language, thus acknowledging their society.

==Known words==
[[File:Dug_writing.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Doge/Legends|Doge]] [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]] reads a scroll about the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] written in the Dug language]]
*Asyui-ln ("not")
*Chicka ("this")
*Dai ("yours")
*Etchoota! ("What's your problem?")<ref name="JJTM" />
*Gongadan! ("Don't trip on your way out!" used as an aggressive farewell)<ref name="JJTM" />
*Poodoo ("fodder")
*Alec ("him")
*Alen ("she")
*Speden ("speeder")
*slimo ( slimeball )
*Yoka (you)
*to (are)
*oda (scum)
*chouwa (again)
